[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
James Glasgow was born on 22 August 1797 in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland, according to the Findmypast transcript, which explicitly labels this the birth date. It records his father as Robt Glasgow, a weaver, and his mother as Eliz Jack.<ref name="FMP1797">Findmypast, ''Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929'', transcript for James Glasgow, Birth date 22 Aug 1797; father Robt Glasgow, occupation Weaver; mother Eliz Jack; OPR 622/4, item 2, p. 30. Transcript captured 3 September 2026; original register image not inspected. [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0396093&tab=this Transcript].</ref>

The existing father-profile assessment selects [[Glasgow-1530|Robert Glasgow]] at 96% (proved). The maternal name is retained as recorded; identity with the existing attached profile [[Jack-2557|Elizabeth Jack]] remains unassessed.<ref name="SP1797">"Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] (accessed 19 April 2025), James Glasgow born or baptised on 22 Aug 1797, son of Robert Glasgow & Elizabeth Jack, in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 622, Ref 40/32. This index does not distinguish birth from baptism; original register image not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1530]] is assessed at 96% (proved). The held ScotlandsPeople Barony citation names James Glasgow, 22 August 1797, as Robert Glasgow’s child with Elizabeth Jack. The 1789 Jack marriage and repeated paired parents identify the adult family convincingly.

The Findmypast transcript explicitly labels 22 August 1797 as the birth date and supplies no baptism date. The ScotlandsPeople citation describes the same date as “born or baptised,” without distinguishing the event. The exact birth date therefore refines the former “before 22 August 1797” boundary; it does not establish a separate baptism date. The original register remains uninspected.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate. “Eliz Jack” is the literal Findmypast maternal reading; her identity with Jack-2557 remains unassessed. This review adds no mother attachment or relationship grade change.

Next useful test: Read the original baptism for residence, occupation and precise mother’s surname.

Source basis already held: [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ "Church of Scotland: Old Parish Registers - Births and Baptisms," database, National Records of Scotland, ScotlandsPeople (https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/) (accessed 19 April 2025), James Glasgow born or baptised on 22 Aug 1797, son of Robert Glasgow & Elizabeth Jack, in Barony, Lanarkshire, Scotland; citing Parish Number 622, Ref 40/32.]. No new father attached; the existing 96% assessment and its source scope remain unchanged.
